about_the_game:
Ruthenia, curses, and stinks: what will you play?

That Friday again is a story-driven puzzle game. You play as Vsevolod, a former prince who has lost everything and is stuck in an endless Friday. This day has a million different endings. One day the city will be attacked by barbarians, another day the leader will change, and one day the gods will kill all the citizens. And it's up to you to decide how the events unfold!

Complete character missions!

Every day is a new choice. Lie, kill, help, poison. What will you do today? To break the curse, you will need to complete the quests of the characters: sometimes it will be to save money, sometimes to help with something, and sometimes to sacrifice all the citizens. For the glory of the gods, of course!

Get unique items!

After completing a mission, you will receive a special item. Find them all, live through many different stories, and ultimately break the curse of the Gods!

short_description: Medieval Ukraine. With black humor, pagan gods, and endless Fridays. You are a former king. Having quarreled with the gods, you lost everything and are stuck in a curse. From now on, you are forced to live the same day forever. Find a way to escape, or you'll be stuck in this cycle forever.
